# Sri Sastha Mahal A/C

> A fully air-conditioned kalyana mandapam suited to Brahmin weddings, with a Vinayagar temple on the premises and 14 A/C rooms for the family.

Website: https://srisasthamahal.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90030 10611

## Contact
- Sri Sastha Mahal A/C · No. 22, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, Hasthinapuram, Chromepet, Chennai 600 064 · +91 90030 10611 · +91 98416 59931 · srisasthamahal@gmail.com

## Key facts
- 500 seats in the A/C hall
- 200 seats in the dining hall
- 14 furnished A/C rooms
- 16 passengers per lift trip

## Facilities
- Fully air-conditioned
- Vinayagar temple on premises
- Valet car parking
- 24-hr CCTV
- Standby generator
- Dual lifts
- Modular kitchen
- Basic pooja items & unjal
- Help with catering, flowers, nadaswaram & video

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sri Sastha Mahal A/C hold?
Sri Sastha Mahal's A/C hall seats 500, and the A/C dining hall seats 200.

### Where is Sri Sastha Mahal A/C?
No. 22, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, Hasthinapuram, Chromepet, Chennai 600 064.

### What facilities does Sri Sastha Mahal A/C have?
Fully air-conditioned, Vinayagar temple on premises, Valet car parking, 24-hr CCTV, Standby generator, Dual lifts, Modular kitchen, Basic pooja items & unjal, Help with catering, flowers, nadaswaram & video.

### Is there a temple at the hall?
Yes. A Vinayagar temple is within the premises, and basic pooja items and an unjal are available.

### Are rooms available for the family?
Yes, 14 furnished A/C rooms with double beds, attached bathrooms and geysers.

### How do I check if Sri Sastha Mahal A/C is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 90030 10611.
